WITH trans_avgs AS (
  SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) as trans_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE anlycount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY transref
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(trans_avg) as overall_average
  FROM trans_avgs
),
kept_trans AS (
  SELECT ta.transref, ta.trans_avg
  FROM trans_avgs ta
  WHERE ta.trans_avg > (SELECT overall_average FROM overall_avg)
),
kept_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(trans_avg) as kept_trans_average
  FROM kept_trans
),
with_diffs AS (
  SELECT
    kt.transref,
    kt.trans_avg,
    kt.trans_avg - (SELECT overall_average FROM overall_avg) as above_overall,
    kt.trans_avg - (SELECT kept_trans_average FROM kept_avg) as above_kept
  FROM kept_trans kt
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    transref,
    trans_avg,
    above_overall,
    above_kept,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY above_kept DESC) as rn
  FROM with_diffs
)
SELECT transref, trans_avg, above_overall, above_kept
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 10 
   OR above_kept = (SELECT above_kept FROM ranked WHERE rn = 10)
ORDER BY above_kept DESC
